text: BondBloxx投资管理公司高级投资策略师乔安妮·比安科表示，投资者认为美国中期选举结果对债券和股票市场构成支撑，因为选举结果提高了进一步扩大财政支出的门槛，也增加了政策受到更多制衡的可能性。她指出，尽管如今华盛顿已很难找到真正主张财政紧缩的鹰派人士，但政策环境更加分散，应该会使财政赤字进一步扩大的难度增加，并有望改善财政前景。比安科在一份报告中表示，展望未来，市场关注焦点将重新转向地缘政治局势，以及美国经济能否继续保持稳健。
text_en: Joanne Bianco, senior investment strategist at BondBloxx Investment Management, said investors believe the US midterm election results are supportive for bond and stock markets, because the outcome raises the threshold for further fiscal spending expansion and increases the likelihood of more checks and balances on policy. She noted that although it is now difficult to find genuine fiscal-hawk voices in Washington, a more fragmented policy environment should make it harder for the fiscal deficit to expand further and could improve the fiscal outlook. Bianco said in a report that looking ahead, market focus will shift back to geopolitical developments and whether the US economy can remain sound.
